items.title: Ladybird's first alpha release
items.summary: Ladybird 浏览器发布了首个 alpha 版本，支持 macOS 和 Linux 直接安装，其核心架构包含 HTML 解析、CSS 引擎、JavaScript 及 WebAssembly 等自研组件，并采用多进程隔离模型。该项目利用 AI 编码代理（如 Claude Code 和 Codex）在两个月内将 JavaScript 引擎的 2.5 万行代码从 C++ 移植为 Rust，并在 2026 年 10 月通过 AI 代理修复功能，在约 225 万项 web-platform-tests 子测试中新增 75,650 项通过，测试成绩超越 Safari，同时其新的 WebAssembly 引擎在 JetStream 3 基准测试中实现了 7 倍性能提升。
items.why_now: Ladybird 首个 Alpha 版今晨发布，首次免编译即可安装，且 10 月底刚完成性能飞跃。
items.why_now_en: Ladybird ships installable alpha on Mac and Linux.
items.summary_en: Ladybird, a 2026 browser with custom HTML, CSS, and JavaScript engines, released its first alpha version for macOS and Linux, enabling installation without manual compilation. In October 2026, the project achieved a 75,650-point increase in web-platform-test passes—surpassing Safari—by utilizing AI coding agents like Claude Code and Codex to port 25,000 lines of code to Rust and fix missing CSS and editing functionality.

items.title: OpenClaw for executives: Automate every 1% annoyance | Ankit Maheshwari (Innovaccer)
items.summary: Innovaccer CTO Ankit Maheshwari deploys "OpenClaw Jarvis" on a Mac Mini to automate daily annoyances, extending from approving Navan flights and ordering DoorDash lunch to making phone calls via Bland AI and controlling smart home devices. The system utilizes "soul files" and split subagents, such as a dedicated voice-calling agent, to prevent global hallucinations and ensure reliable task execution. Maheshwari is currently testing GLM 5.3 Flash to replace his $500-to-$600 monthly Anthropic bill, evaluating whether local models can maintain performance for these automation workflows.
items.why_now: GLM 5.3 Flash上线，正被用于实测能否替代每月500-600美元的Anthropic账单。
items.why_now_en: GLM 5.3 Flash could slash your $500-mo AI bill
items.summary_en: Ankit Maheshwari, CTO of Innovaccer, demonstrates how his "OpenClaw" automation system on a Mac Mini resolves 1% annoyances by using soul files and specialized subagents for tasks ranging from Navan flight approvals to ordering lunch and managing smart home devices. By splitting complex functions like voice calling into distinct subagents, he avoids the hallucinations caused by a single global agent, ensuring trustworthy execution with defined guardrails. Maheshwari is currently evaluating the GLM 5.3 Flash local model as a cost-effective alternative to his current $500–$600 monthly Anthropic billing.

items.title: 🎙️ How I AI: OpenClaw for executives: Automate every 1% annoyance
items.summary: Innovaccer CTO Ankit Maheshwari 基于 OpenClaw 在 Mac Mini 上构建了个人 AI 参谋，通过设置每 4 小时运行的 Cron 任务自动汇总简历审批，并部署语音专家子代理处理午餐订购、餐厅预订及未读 Slack 消息等碎片化任务。该系统利用 soul.md 文件定义代理性格与权限边界，在 Opus 5.5 模型每月约 $500-$600 的成本下，成功实现了无需逐步授权的自主执行能力，且初步测试表明本地模型可承担摘要与邮件处理等基础工作以降低开支。
items.why_now: OpenClaw 支持用免费本地模型替代高昂 API 处理常规任务，正处成本优化窗口期。
items.why_now_en: OpenClaw agents now cut frontier model bills via local routing.
items.summary_en: Ankit Maheshwari, CTO of Innovaccer, utilizes OpenClaw on a Mac Mini to deploy a personal AI chief of staff that autonomously handles tasks ranging from resume approval digests and smart home control to calling coworkers who miss Slack messages, achieving reliability through strict soul file guardrails and narrowly scoped specialist subagents. The system currently costs $500 to $600 monthly using Anthropic's Opus 5.5 model, though early tests indicate local models can handle routine summarization and email tasks for nearly free while reserving frontier models for complex browser automation. By applying a "1% annoyance" rule to identify bottlenecks and using a terminal-first setup that leverages Claude Code for implementation, Maheshwari demonstrates how agent autonomy and persistent learning—such as adapting to specific dietary preferences—outperform generalist AI workflows.

items.title: HKUDS/CLI-Anything
items.summary: HKUDS 推出的 CLI-Anything 项目通过统一的命令行接口将各类软件转化为 AI 智能体（Agent）可原生操作的格式，支持 Pi、Cursor、Claude Code 等工具直接调用。该生态已集成 ArcGIS Pro、Obsidian、Joplin、Unreal Editor 等主流软件，并建立了包含 134 项测试验证的社区注册中心 CLI-Hub，用户可通过 `pip install cli-anything-hub` 实现软件浏览、安装与管理的一体化操作。
items.why_now_en: Merged CLIs for MiniMax and ArcGIS Pro open an immediate agent-integration window.
items.summary_en: HKUDS's CLI-Anything is an open-source framework that generates agent-native command-line interfaces for diverse software, enabling AI agents to automate tasks across tools like ArcGIS Pro, Obsidian, and Unreal Engine. The project supports over 100 community-contributed CLIs, including merged modules for Calibre, Rekordbox, and MiniMax, all manageable via the central `cli-anything-hub` pip package. Recent updates hardened security by routing untrusted XML/SVG input through defusedxml and standardized skill installation via a unified `skills/` directory.

items.title: zhouxiaoka/autoclip
items.summary: 开源AI视频剪辑工具AutoClip支持通过粘贴链接自动将长视频转化为适配抖音、TikTok、小红书等平台的短视频，并自动生成字幕、封面及发布文案。该软件采用本地渲染结合云端按量计费模式，在Apple Silicon Mac上实测将1小时43分钟或近3小时的原片处理为10条合格片段，耗时约7.5至29.5分钟，文字模型估算成本仅0.09至0.20元人民币。
items.why_now: 开源 AutoClip 发布桌面版，本地剪辑渲染仅需几分钱，一键出片适配多平台。
items.why_now_en: Open-source local AI clipping tool released
items.summary_en: AutoClip is an open-source desktop AI tool that automatically converts long videos into short clips for platforms like TikTok, Douyin, and YouTube Shorts, generating subtitles, covers, and captions while keeping video rendering local on the user's machine. The software is free to use but charges on a per-usage basis for cloud-based analysis models; processing a one-hour video incurs an estimated text-model cost of just ¥0.09, with total processing times ranging from 7.5 to 65 minutes depending on the version and input.

items.title: What one RTX 3090 can do with a local LLM (our numbers)
items.summary: 在双 RTX 3090 配置的本地环境下，混合专家模型 Qwen3.6 35B-A3B 凭借仅 3B 激活参数实现了 88-103 tokens/s 的推理速度，单卡即可运行并耗时约 2 分钟完成 6 项多步骤代理任务，表现优于双卡运行的 Qwen3.8 27B（后者耗时 4 分钟且速度慢 40%）。测试表明，模型读取 25,000 长 prompt 的速度对代理任务效率影响显著，Qwen3-VL 8B 虽处理简单问题最快（0.5s/题）但仅能完成 50% 的复杂任务，因此该付费本地代理 Concierge LLM 最终选用 35B 模型以平衡单卡显存占用与 Premiere 等创意软件的需求。
items.why_now: Qwen3.6 35B-A3B 已可单张 3090 本地流畅运行多步 Agent 任务，窗口期已至。
items.why_now_en: 35B MoE agents now fit one RTX 3090
items.summary_en: On a single RTX 3090, the Qwen3.6 35B-A3B mixture-of-experts model achieves 88–103 tokens/second and completes complex multi-step agent tasks in approximately two minutes, outperforming the Qwen3.8 27B on dual 3090s by roughly 40% in daily use. While the Qwen3-VL 8B handles simple queries at a faster 52–80 tokens/second, it fails half of longer agentic jobs, making the 35B-A3B the recommended local model for reliable multi-tool workflows.

items.title: [AINews] Jensen Is Back! and OpenAI Shows Its Pretraining Curve, joined by Microsoft
items.summary: 英伟达董事会一致投票让黄仁修在离职11天后重返CEO及董事会，此前美国财政部部长和总统介入调查，公司同时成立国家安全与出口管制委员会；OpenAI首席科学家Jakub Pachocki公布预训练困惑度曲线，揭示GPT-3.5（0.99）至GPT-6 Astra（0.76）的下降轨迹，并预测困惑度降至0.68–0.70时将引发能力跃升，微软 Mustafa Suleyman 率先响应提议，在相同测试集上报告 MAI-2 Base 模型得分为0.819。
items.why_now: OpenAI首曝预训练曲线并邀微软自测，确立以困惑度0.68–0.7为前沿能力爆发门槛的自监管共识。
items.why_now_en: Jensen Huang returns as Nvidia CEO 11 days post-resignation
items.summary_en: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang returned to his role eleven days after resignation following a unanimous board vote influenced by U.S. Treasury and Presidential officials, who simultaneously established a new national security committee. Concurrently, OpenAI published its pretraining loss curve, showing base-model log-perplexity dropping from 0.99 for GPT-3.5 to 0.91 for GPT-4, while predicting that frontier capabilities will accelerate when perplexity reaches the 0.68–0.70 range, a milestone currently approached by Microsoft’s MAI-2 Base at 0.819.

items.title: Sierra doubles valuation to $30B within six months as demand for AI in CX takes off
items.summary: Sierra 完成17.5亿美元F轮融资，估值在六个月内从150亿美元翻倍至300亿美元，由Greenoaks和Lightspeed领投。该公司服务近50%的财富500强企业，通过结果导向定价模式在5个月内将年化收入翻倍至4亿美元，并正与Meta、Stripe等公司合作制定AI代理协议标准。
items.why_now: Sierra六个月内估值翻倍至$30B且营收激增，验证企业级AI代理市场爆发窗口。
items.why_now_en: $30B valuation opens a window for CX agent protocols.
items.summary_en: Sierra raised $1.75 billion in a Series F round, doubling its valuation to $30 billion within six months, led by Greenoaks and Lightspeed Venture Partners. The enterprise customer experience company doubled its run-rate revenue to $400 million in five months through an outcome-based pricing model, now serving nearly 50% of the Fortune 50 with clients including BNY, HSBC, and JPMorganChase.

items.title: 刚刚，Claude 黎曼猜想证明的主导者回应一切
items.summary: Anthropic 数学家 Levent Alpöge 澄清“25 万页”证明系玩笑，但承认其与 Claude 耗时 41 天协作完成的黎曼猜想形式化证明存在大量代码冗余，该证明由 1751 万个 Lean 源文件组成（约 1737 万行代码）。相比 8 月 Claude 独立将黎曼 zeta 函数零点比例下界从 41.6% 提升至 67.2% 的技术路线，此次成果虽经 Lean 社区核验但尚未获克雷数学研究所正式认可，且暴露了 AI 生成证明速度远超人类消化速度、导致代码质量难以在发布前整理的核心矛盾。
items.topic: AI 新技术 / 新模型
items.why_now: Claude刚完成黎曼猜想形式化证明，独立开发者可借Lean代码库探索AI辅助数学研究新范式。
items.why_now_en: Claude's Riemann proof launch triggered a forced early release of a rival's 12-year work.
items.summary_en: Anthropic mathematician Levent Alpöge clarified that the claim of a 250,000-page formalized proof of the Riemann Hypothesis generated with Claude was a joke, while confirming the actual Lean codebase comprises 17.37 million lines across 175,187 files. This 41-day collaborative project, completed in November 2024, yielded a formalized proof of the Riemann and Generalized Riemann Hypotheses that passed community verification despite acknowledged code redundancy. The incident highlights the emerging challenge where AI-generated proofs are produced faster than humans can fully digest and simplify them.

items.title: elementalsouls/Claude-BugHunter
items.summary: Claude-BugHunter是一款包含83项技能和15条斜杠命令的Claude Code技能包，通过整合681个已披露的HackerOne报告模式及24类核心漏洞，将Claude Code转化为专注于外部红队与漏洞挖掘的自动化工具。该工具支持通过插件或脚本一键安装，利用主题触发机制自动加载相应技能，并集成了Burp MCP及M365、Okta等企业级攻击矩阵，在DVWA、OWASP Juice Shop等授权环境中验证了其实用性。
items.why_now: Claude Code新增插件功能支持83个安全审计技能，使AI即刻具备红队实战能力。
items.why_now_en: New Claude Code bundle turns AI into a red-teamer with 2026 CVEs.
items.summary_en: Claude-BugHunter is a self-contained skill bundle for Claude Code containing 83 skills, 15 slash commands, and 681 disclosed-report patterns across 24 vulnerability classes to facilitate automated bug hunting and red-team operations. The system operates via a four-layer architecture that automatically loads specialized modules for web application vulnerabilities, enterprise infrastructure CVE chains (2024–2026), and report generation based on natural language inputs. Installation is supported through a plugin marketplace for namespaced updates or a manual git clone script, with optional HackerOne API integration for private program access.

items.title: obra/superpowers
items.summary: Superpowers是由obra开发的代理技能框架，支持Claude Code、Codex、Cursor等十余款主流编码工具，可通过命令行如`/plugin install superpowers`快速集成。该框架强制执行红绿TDD、YAGNI和DRY原则，通过子代理驱动开发流程使编码智能体可连续自主工作数小时，显著提升了软件开发的规范性与效率。
items.summary_en: Superpowers is a composable agentic skills framework and software development methodology that integrates into coding agents like Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor to enforce a structured workflow of specification gathering, YAGNI-based planning, and subagent-driven red/green TDD. The system enables autonomous agent execution for extended periods by automatically triggering pre-defined skills, ensuring code generation adheres to strict design constraints and quality checks before implementation.

items.title: Amazon snaps up Decart’s AI optimization tech for $7.5B as it prepares to sell Trainium chips
items.summary: 亚马逊以75亿美元收购以色列初创公司Decart，将其核心的Decart优化栈（DOS）技术及创始团队纳入麾下，该架构能显著提升AI模型在Nvidia、Amazon及Google硬件上的运行效率。此举旨在配合亚马逊即将对外销售自研Trainium芯片的战略，通过降低算力门槛并优化推理成本，使其成为Nvidia的有力竞争者，从而推动客户工作负载向亚马逊芯片迁移。
items.summary_en: Amazon is acquiring Israeli startup Decart for $7.5 billion to secure its Decart Optimization Stack (DOS), a software layer that enables efficient AI model execution on Nvidia, Amazon, and Google hardware. Amazon will also acquire Decart’s founding team and researchers to support its strategy of selling Trainium chips to external customers as a competitive alternative to Nvidia, leveraging DOS to lower inference and training costs.

items.title: Claude helps solve math's biggest open problem
items.summary: Anthropic 数学家 Levent Alpöge 利用 Claude 在约 6 周内解决了 167 年悬而未决的黎曼猜想，该证明由 Lean 团队认证，但 1700 万行代码的机器可读格式引发了人类数学协会对其理解性的争议。尽管该突破目前主要体现为理论意义，但其展现的解题速度远超顶尖数学家的预期，若应用于生物学和药物设计等复杂领域，将带来显著的实质性收益。
items.why_now: Claude证实黎曼猜想且Lean于周六完成验证，AI加速解决百年难题的窗口已开启。
items.why_now_en: Lean certification of Riemann proof happened this Saturday.
items.summary_en: Anthropic mathematician Levent Alpöge utilized Claude to prove the Riemann hypothesis in approximately six weeks, producing a 17 million-line machine-checkable proof that the Lean verification teams have certified as correct. This breakthrough resolves a 167-year-old prime-number puzzle that carries a $1 million Millennium Prize, significantly outpacing the decades of human theoretical work previously expected to solve it.

items.title: 字节，该造手机了
AI 降本增笑，全世界都在被迫接受审美大降级
a16z 实测 11,307 次 Agent 购物流程，总结企业赢得 B2A 经济的五条方法
items.why_now: a16z 刚实测 11,307 次 Agent 购物，揭示 B2A 经济窗口，企业需即刻调整以应对新流量。

items.title: Anthropic launches Claude Ship, letting AI agents review, fix, and approve code changes
items.summary: Anthropic 推出 Claude Ship 工具套件，旨在通过自动化审查与审批流程解决 AI 生成代码带来的合并瓶颈。该方案包含已全面开放的 Code Review，以及处于测试阶段的 PR Steward（处理 CI 失败与冲突）和 Claude Approvals（基于自然语言策略自动批准更改），支持在 GitHub 仓库中配置观察模式、月度支出限制及人工升级机制。目前，该工具正面向 Claude Team 和 Enterprise 用户推出。
items.summary_en: Anthropic has launched Claude Ship, a suite of AI agents for GitHub that automates code review, fix, and approval processes to address bottlenecks caused by agent-generated code. The platform features Code Review (currently generally available) alongside two new beta agents: PR Steward, which resolves CI failures and merge conflicts, and Claude Approvals, which automatically merges changes based on team-defined natural-language policies and signals. Anthropic is rolling out the tool to its Team and Enterprise plans, offering observability controls and configurable review depths (Quick, Standard, or Deep) to maintain human oversight over automated decisions.

items.title: 蚂蚁OceanBase发布湖库一体AI数据平台OceanLake，核心引擎向全球开源
items.summary: 蚂蚁OceanBase正式发布湖库一体AI数据平台OceanLake并全球开源核心引擎OceanSeek，该平台融合数据库实时处理、数据仓库分析与数据湖开放存储，统一管理多模态数据，显著降低Agent开发门槛；应用落地显示，其帮助平安寿险将典型取数交付时间从2-5天缩短至约15分钟，并支撑蚂蚁灵光超过3000万个“闪应用”运行及蚂蚁阿福模型评测环境准备从天级缩短至分钟级。

items.title: 具身行业，终于等来了自己的通用智能时刻
items.summary: 自变量机器人发布具身基础模型WALL-OSS-1.0，通过视觉、语言与动作联合预训练实现零样本通用智能，在语义任务上成功率达78%，较π0.5模型高出70.8%，其轻量化Lite版本在RoboDojo仿真赛道登顶。该模型通过引入无本体数据与Agent驱动接管机制降低数据成本，单次推理延迟降至60毫秒以内，并配套推出行业首个具身基础模型API——WALL-API-1.0，支持开箱即用，取代旧版WALL-OSS-0.5成为旗舰模型。

items.title: Supertake raises $20M to let AI agents turn your market predictions into stock portfolios
items.summary: AI投资初创公司Supertake获得由Adjacent领投的2000万美元种子轮融资，旨在通过前沿AI模型和交易代理，将用户的自然语言市场预测转化为实际股票投资组合。该产品目前支持Coinbase和Robinhood平台，利用AI与用户迭代生成可投资的“观点”，并通过公开排行榜实现同类观点用户的联合投资，未来计划扩展至衍生品及预测市场等资产类别。
items.summary_en: Supertake, an AI investing startup led by former Coinbase AI heads Lincoln Murr and John Peterson, raised $20 million in seed funding led by Adjacent to let users convert natural language market predictions into executable stock portfolios using frontier AI agents and proprietary controls. The platform, which integrates with brokerages like Coinbase and Robinhood, features a leaderboard for social investment coordination and plans to expand into shorts, derivatives, and prediction markets beyond its current equity-only focus.

items.title: Google DeepMind 用 Gemini 4 智能体团队与 Lean 形式化验证改进量子算法
items.summary: Google DeepMind 发布论文，利用多个 Gemini 4 智能体团队结合 Lean 形式化定理证明器优化量子算法，并在 GitHub 开源相关 Lean 库与验证解法。该方法在惯性约束聚变模拟中将计算成本降低 11.8 倍、内存从 5,650 个纠错量子比特降至 4,338 个，并在细胞色素 P450 酶模拟中实现 2.5 倍改进、内存从 481 个降至 333 个量子比特；此外还使 Grover 算法加速 2.57 倍、arcsin 构件加速 290 倍。相比传统人工设计，这种经数学证明检查的 AI 搜索方式能大幅压缩研究时间，将量子算法优化迁移至其他科研领域。
items.summary_en: Google DeepMind leveraged a multi-agent team powered by Gemini 4 and Lean formal verification to optimize quantum algorithms, reducing computational costs for inertial confinement fusion simulations by 11.8x and lowering memory requirements from 5,650 to 4,338 error-corrected qubits. The agents also achieved an 8x cost reduction in photosensitive molecule simulations, improved cytochrome P450 modeling by 2.5x, and accelerated Grover's algorithm and arcsin routines by 2.57x and 290x, respectively. The research open-sourced its Lean library, problem specifications, and verified solutions on GitHub, demonstrating that proven-checked AI search can compress years of manual circuit design into automated workflows.

items.title: Elon Musk and others rejoice as Jensen Huang is reinstated at Nvidia amid scandal
items.summary: 英伟达在卷入涉及中国间谍的三起婚外情丑闻及多项国会国安调查后，于周一正式恢复Jensen Huang的CEO及总裁职务。尽管Elon Musk、Sam Altman等科技界高管对此表示欢迎，但美国参议员John Cornyn和Pete Ricketts仍质疑其国家安全风险，并确认Huang将于12月3日出席参议院银行委员会听证，同时需向三个众议院委员会进行闭门作证。
items.summary_en: Jensen Huang was reinstated as CEO and president of Nvidia following a scandal involving three affairs and an alleged Chinese spy, despite triggering multiple congressional investigations over national security concerns. While tech leaders including Elon Musk and Sam Altman celebrated his return with comparisons to past executive reinstatements, political figures such as Senators John Cornyn and Pete Ricketts remain skeptical of President Trump's assurance that there is no security risk. Huang is scheduled to testify before the Senate Banking Committee on December 3 and three House committees.

items.title: 「试用期」已到，苹果开始给 AI 收费了 | AG&I
items.summary: 苹果在 iOS 27.3 测试版中引入 Siri AI 及云端功能的每日使用限额，需通过升级 200GB 及以上 iCloud+ 订阅（最高 20 倍额度加成）获取额外算力，设备端基础指令仍免费。国内华为小艺 AI 会员采取积分制（49 元/月起），小米超级小爱 2.0 则对专家模式消耗积分（每月 1000 免费积分），行业普遍采用积分或额度池替代 Token 计费以优化用户体验。
items.summary_en: Apple introduced a usage-based billing model for AI services in the iOS 27.3 developer beta, restricting heavy cloud-dependent features like Siri AI and image generation by categorizing them into independent daily quotas rather than a universal token pool. Users exceeding free device-level limits must purchase iCloud+ tiers of 200GB or more, ranging from $200GB to 2TB, to unlock 2x to 20x data boosts, with subscription changes auto-renewing monthly. This mirrors industry trends where Chinese vendors like Huawei and Xiaomi are implementing point-based systems (e.g., Huawei's 49 CNY/month plan) to manage the server costs associated with advanced AI agents and cloud inference.

items.title: 刚刚，黄仁勋重返英伟达！董事会全票通过，盘前大涨 30%
items.summary: 英伟达董事会于11月23日全票通过决议，正式恢复黄仁勋的CEO、总裁及董事职务，使其在突然辞职11天后重新掌舵，促使英伟达股价在消息公布后开盘一度暴涨超过30%。此次回归的关键在于董事会在与黄仁勋沟通及征询美国政府高级官员意见后改变立场，认定其继续领导符合公司最佳利益，尽管针对其此前争议的内部独立调查及SEC的会计审查仍在进行中。
items.summary_en: NVIDIA’s board of directors unanimously reinstated Jensen Huang as President and CEO, effective immediately on November 23, reversing a previous decision six days after he resigned amid a personal controversy. Upon the announcement of his return, NVIDIA’s stock surged over 30% in pre-market trading, effectively ending a period of uncertainty that had contributed to the company's worst weekly stock decline since 2008. Huang resumed executive control while a special committee continues its independent investigation, with Colette Kress retaining her role as CFO.

items.title: Nvidia Reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO
items.summary: Nvidia 董事会在一番与美政府高层的沟通后，因确认黄仁勋（Jensen Huang）的回归不存在国家安全风险，于周一一致同意立即恢复其 CEO 职务，此前他因多段婚外情及与涉嫌中国间谍相关的女性交往而辞职，导致股价自 11 月 8 日承认恋情以来下跌近 33%。在特朗普等政商领袖的强烈呼吁及 Wachtell 律所调查中未发现违法证据后，黄仁勋的回归令 Nvidia 股价在当日飙升 31%。目前，CFO Colette Kress 继续任职，而针对该事件的独立调查委员会将保留以继续完成相关程序。
items.summary_en: Nvidia reinstated Jensen Huang as CEO effective immediately after a unanimous board vote, following a scandal involving extramarital affairs with a suspected Chinese spy that triggered a 31% stock surge and wiped out a prior 33% decline. The reinstatement was accelerated by reassurances from senior U.S. government officials, including President Donald Trump, that no national security laws were violated and that Huang did not engage in unlawful conduct.

directions.name: Model Benchmark Radar
directions.description: 聚合主流AI模型在标准测试集上的困惑度与性能指标，提供实时对比仪表盘及能力跃升预测分析。
directions.description_en: Aggregates perplexity and performance metrics of major AI models on standard test sets, providing a real-time comparison dashboard and capability leap predictions.
directions.target_user: AI工程师、技术决策者、研究者
directions.target_user_en: AI Engineers, Technical Decision Makers, Researchers
core_features: 自动抓取并解析最新模型技术报告中的基准测试数据
可视化展示不同模型在相同测试集上的困惑度轨迹与排名
基于历史数据预测下一代模型的能力跃升区间
core_features_en: Automatically scrape and parse benchmark test data from latest model technical reports
Visualize perplexity trajectories and rankings of different models on identical test sets
Predict capability leap intervals for next-generation models based on historical data
directions.why_now: OpenAI 首席科学家公开预训练困惑度曲线引发社区热议，且微软迅速跟进报告自家模型得分，显示出业界对标准化基准透明度的强烈需求。当前缺乏统一工具来自动聚合这些分散在博客和论文中的数据，社区讨论（Hacker News/Reddit）中关于“如何公平比较不同测试集结果”的痛点突出，现在是建立中立基准雷达的最佳窗口期。
directions.why_now_en: OpenAI's chief scientist publishing pretraining perplexity curves has sparked intense community discussion, with Microsoft quickly following up by reporting their own model scores, indicating a strong industry demand for standardized benchmark transparency. Currently, there is no unified tool to automatically aggregate this scattered data from blogs and papers. Community discussions (Hacker News/Reddit) highlight the pain point of "fairly comparing results across different test sets," making now the perfect window to build a neutral benchmark radar.
directions.monetization: SaaS订阅模式（Pro版提供API访问及自定义测试集对比功能）
directions.monetization_en: SaaS Subscription Model (Pro tier offers API access and custom test set comparison features)
